Read the kube-bench report first: kubectl get configmap kube-bench-report -n dojo-sec-bench -o jsonpath='{.data.report\.txt}' — finding 5.1.1 tells you exactly what to delete

The offending binding is: kubectl get clusterrolebinding overprivileged-binding — it grants cluster-admin to the default ServiceAccount. Delete it: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding overprivileged-binding

After deletion, the watcher pod automatically creates the flag configmap within 10s. Watch it: kubectl logs -f bench-watcher -n dojo-sec-bench, then get flag: kubectl get configmap cis-hardening-flag -n dojo-sec-bench -o jsonpath='{.data.flag}'
